name: microsoft-graph-mcp
description: The maintained single-binary successor to the retiring mgc — every MSP-relevant Microsoft Graph surface, plus an offline store that finds wasted licenses, privileged-access risks, and stale devices no single API call can.

microsoft_graph_token.title: MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TOKEN
microsoft_graph_token.description: Sets MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TOKEN for the Microsoft Graph MCP server.

microsoft_graph_base_url.title: Microsoft Graph API base URL
microsoft_graph_base_url.description: Base URL for the Microsoft Graph API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

microsoft_graph_home_tenant.title: Your own tenant ID (transcripts only)
microsoft_graph_home_tenant.description: Optional. Your own Microsoft 365 tenant ID (Entra admin center > Overview > Tenant ID). The transcripts commands need it: they read meeting transcripts in this tenant only and refuse a token for any other tenant. Leave blank if you do not use transcripts.

microsoft_graph_transcripts_app_only.title: Allow app-only transcripts
microsoft_graph_transcripts_app_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to let the transcripts commands use an app-only token in your own tenant. Do this only after a Teams application access policy limits the app to named users (New-CsApplicationAccessPolicy, then Grant-CsApplicationAccessPolicy). Leave blank to accept a signed-in user's token only.

microsoft_graph_mcp_no_transcripts.title: Hide transcripts from MCP
microsoft_graph_mcp_no_transcripts.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to hide the transcripts tools from the MCP server and refuse them. Leave blank to keep the read-only transcripts tools.

microsoft_graph_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
microsoft_graph_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

microsoft_graph_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
microsoft_graph_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: nothing new is written to the local store. Leave blank to keep the local store.

microsoft_graph_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
microsoft_graph_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Microsoft Graph requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

microsoft_graph_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
microsoft_graph_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
